claims.sentence: In this study, the role of a chronic treatment with a micromolar dosage of taurine in the physical performance of skeletal muscle of castrated-aged mice was characterized.Taurine was administered in drinking water (800 μM) to 9-months-old castrated (or sham) mice at approximately 20 mg/kg per day for 12 weeks.
